newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Ebos sees flat full-yr pre-tax profit.
newsitem.headline: Ebos sees flat full-yr pre-tax profit.

text.p: Drug and medical supplies company Ebos Group Ltd said on Monday its New Zealand and Australian businesses were on track and it anticipated a full-year pre-tax result close to last year's NZ$4.3 million.
In a statement to the New Zealand Stock Exchange following an extraordinary meeting on Friday, Ebos said its outlook for 1997/98 was for continuing profit growth.
"It is the directors' intention to pay a final dividend of 18 cents per share on the increased capital of the company, making a total dividend of 27 cents per share for the full year," Ebos said.
